reason.text: An Elder Dinosaur that can't be countered and draws off opposing noncreature spells, so a big-dino deck gets a resilient Dinosaur leader.
Makes spells with high mana value cheaper and uncounterable, which suits a deck full of huge creatures that land safely.

reason.text: Doubles token creation itself, so it stacks with a token and counter doubler and fills the board quickly.
Doubles counters you put on permanents, matching a deck that wants counter and token multiplication to pile up.
Adds an extra counter on every counter placement, which compounds with doubled counters on your permanents.
Each token creation also brings a Frog, so doubled tokens turn into a wide board that feeds counters onto itself.
Enters with counters and makes flying Insect tokens, so doubling gives a bigger body and twice the tokens.
Each X spell makes a Hydra token with X counters, and both the token and its counters get doubled.
Makes Squirrel tokens on entering and attacking and can pump out more, all of which get doubled.
Taps to create tokens and can copy every token, so doubled tokens quickly snowball.
Moves counters into Saproling tokens and back, and doubling gives extra of each for a combo-ready engine.
Adds a Food with each token creation, so token doublers multiply the Food and lifegain card draw.
